Flags stay on this device
Tuta has no star, so flags are kept as a label, and %1$s cannot create the \"Flagged\" label: its plan has no room for another label. Tap to use one of the account\'s labels for flags instead.
Label for flags
Messages you flag get this label, in Tuna Mail and in Tuta\'s own apps, and messages with it show as flagged.
